motive: Raymond's franchise deal fell through when Aris told the buyers the coffee machines he'd sold them were scrap she had patched up for him. He went to the maker space to make her take it back.

facts.what: Raymond smashed up the maker space and attacked Aris in the lane behind it, tearing her steel hand half off.

known_by.cover: I was at home going over the accounts all night.

facts.what: Raymond blamed Aris for losing his franchise deal: she told the buyers the coffee machines he'd sold them were scrap she had patched up for him.

known_by.cover: Aris and I always got on fine.

leads.text: Raymond had it in for Aris. Ask him where he was the night she was attacked.

facts.what: Tobias heard shouting and breaking glass from the maker space just before midnight.

leads.text: Kofi paints in the lane at night. Ask him what he saw.

facts.what: Kofi was painting the wall at the end of the lane and saw a big man in a long coat run from the maker space, holding his arm.

leads.text: A big man in a long coat, holding his arm. Raymond wears a coat like that: ask him where he was.

facts.what: Aris wrote in her notes that R. came about the machines again. She told him no, and he said she'd regret it.

leads.text: Who's R., and which machines? Marguerite knows everyone's business: ask her.
Tobias walks the high street late. Ask him about that night.

motive: Henrietta's petition to close the maker space failed when Aris showed the council its safety logs. Raymond wanted the building for a franchise, and Priya blamed Aris's late welding for the noise complaints that shut her terrace. They went together to frighten her into leaving, and it went too far.

facts.what: Henrietta, Raymond and Priya smashed up the maker space and attacked Aris in the lane behind it, tearing her steel hand half off.

known_by.cover: I was in bed by ten, as I always am.
I was at home going over the accounts all night.
I was behind the bar till two. Ask anyone.

facts.what: Henrietta, Raymond and Priya met at the noodle bar the evening before and talked about sorting out the maker space once and for all.

leads.text: Henrietta, Raymond and Priya were planning something. Ask each of them where they were that night.

facts.what: A Residents' Association lanyard was caught on the maker space's broken window.

leads.text: Henrietta runs the Residents' Association. Lachlan eats at the noodle bar most nights: ask him who she's been meeting.

facts.what: Desmond saw Priya at the tap in the square after midnight, washing a cut on her hand.

leads.text: Priya cut her hand that night. Ask her how.
